responsibility: Defines the ISO dynamic storage allocation interface for gm2. It declares ALLOCATE, DEALLOCATE, and GNU extension REALLOCATE over SYSTEM.ADDRESS, plus the StorageExceptions family and queries for whether the current exceptional execution came from this module and which storage error occurred, making it the public heap-management API used by library and user code.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public specification for heap allocation and storage-related exceptions, declaring ALLOCATE/DEALLOCATE/REALLOCATE and exception queries, whereas Storage.mod implements allocation tracking and exception raising mechanics.
